partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Dual translational assertion causal-target mechanism
results.hypothesis: A causal-target prediction supported independently by both clinical-trial and applied-treatment assertions should form a high-precision discovery rule while retaining an unlabeled prediction.
results.body: R030 plus applied_to_treat for the same drug-disease pair
results.mechanism_rationale: Combines directional target perturbation and causal disease genetics with two distinct treatment-oriented assertions, but those assertions are not independent of therapeutic knowledge and disease activity direction remains absent.
results.trapi_notes: The causal-target, clinical-trial, and applied-treatment motifs are TRAPI-expressible; provenance, evidence rescue, degree, ontology, and negative-existence constraints require Cypher or post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
      -[:CAUSES]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (subject)-[trial:IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR]->(object)
MATCH (subject)-[:APPLIED_TO_TREAT]->(object)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 50
  AND (
    evidence._miner_gene_causal_disease_degree <= 12
    OR (
      evidence._miner_causal_publication_count >= 3
      AND evidence._miner_causal_publication_npmi >= 0.5
      AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
    )
  )
  AND 'infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials'
      IN coalesce(trial.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Applied-treatment clinical-or-anatomy rescue, selective
results.hypothesis: An applied-treatment assertion is more predictive when a selective drug also has either independent clinical-trial support or repeated Bgee and disease-anatomy concordance.
results.body: R023 with qualified target degree <=32 and either multiomics clinical-trial evidence or >=3 shared Bgee disease anatomies
results.mechanism_rationale: Uses a direct causal-target mechanism, selective perturbation, and either independent translational evidence or repeated anatomical concordance; the applied-treatment edge remains treatment-oriented and disease activity direction is missing.
results.trapi_notes: The positive causal-target, applied-treatment, clinical, and anatomy motifs are separately TRAPI-expressible; the OR branch, repeated-anatomy cardinality, degree, provenance, ontology, and negative constraints require Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
      -[:CAUSES]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (subject)-[:APPLIED_TO_TREAT]->(object)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 32
  AND (
    evidence._miner_bgee_anatomy_count >= 3
    OR EXISTS {
      MATCH (subject)-[trial:IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR]->(object)
      WHERE 'infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials'
            IN coalesce(trial.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
    }
  )
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Anatomy-supported translational evidence union, selective
results.hypothesis: Repeated anatomical concordance can support a causal-target prediction when either applied-treatment or independent clinical-trial evidence is present, increasing recall without returning to the broad evidence-only rules.
results.body: causal-target mechanism with >=3 shared Bgee disease anatomies, qualified target degree <=30, and applied_to_treat OR multiomics clinical-trial evidence
results.mechanism_rationale: Requires repeated graph-internal anatomical concordance around the causal target and at least one translational evidence branch, but the evidence disjunction remains treatment-oriented and disease activity direction is unresolved.
results.trapi_notes: Each positive branch is TRAPI-expressible separately; the evidence OR, repeated-anatomy cardinality, degree, provenance, ontology, and negative constraints require Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
      -[:CAUSES]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 30
  AND evidence._miner_bgee_anatomy_count >= 3
  AND (
    EXISTS {
      MATCH (subject)-[:APPLIED_TO_TREAT]->(object)
    }
    OR EXISTS {
      MATCH (subject)-[trial:IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR]->(object)
      WHERE 'infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials'
            IN coalesce(trial.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
    }

  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
